response.rationale: The item is a clearance, final-sale item (final_sale == True), which makes RET-012 apply. RET-012 has the highest priority (100) and dominates the standard 30-day window rule (RET-007). Although delivery was only 12 days ago, final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. The defective flag is null, so the defective exception (RET-020) does not apply.
